overview: A pinata block, a rainbow jeb_ sheep hanging there, that spills its loot when it has been hit enough times.
There is no recipe: an operator hangs one up, or a village that thinks well of you throws the party itself.

1.0.2: A pinata counts as solid, so flowing water stands against it instead of washing it away.
1.0.1: A pinata spills the exact item it was given, name and enchantments and all.
Its tip card names what is hanging there rather than the sheep inside it.
1.0.0: The pinata block, and /pinata spawn to hang a fully configured one.
A hand-placed pinata carries a modest default of sweets.
A village that likes you enough will put one up on its own.
Every child walks over and stands around it until it breaks or the light starts to go.
